comment: Index of the game packages the Plaza renders. This file is the ONLY
mutable part of the games workspace: adding, removing, reordering or
hot-fixing a game is an edit here plus (optionally) a new directory.
baseUrl resolution:
- a leading-slash path ('/games/<id>/') is served by Caddy from
/var/www/drone-navigation/games/ on ECS 1 — the repo-root games/
directory rsynced to a path that mirrors the URL exactly, so
/games/x/y is /var/www/drone-navigation/games/x/y. It is pinned to
the APEX origin, never the CDN edge, so a fix shows up on the next
visit instead of after edge propagation.
- an absolute URL is used verbatim. That is the slot for packages
published from their own repositories and served from a CDN, e.g.
'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/<org>/<repo>@<tag>/'. Pointing a game
at a locally patched copy under /games/ is the hot-fix path: no git
tag and no CDN propagation to wait for.
Every baseUrl must contain a card.json — the only file the Plaza needs to
draw a card. Package media (trailer, poster, meshes) and the agent
package.json / story.json / audio.json / index.js live beside it and are
addressed RELATIVE to baseUrl, so moving a package to another host is a
one-field change here.
Deliberately NOT inlined here: a package's title and copy belong to the
package, so a game published from its own repository owns its own card
text and adding it to the Plaza is one {id, baseUrl} entry. If the
catalog ever grows to hundreds of games the N+1 fetch becomes a
waterfall; the fix is to lift a short teaser into each entry below,
which needs no client change beyond reading it.
Entry fields:
id              stable identifier; must match the package's card.json.
baseUrl         package root, leading-slash (this server) or absolute.
packageVersion  cache-buster for card.json: the client requests
'card.json?v=<packageVersion>', so bumping this is what
publishes a card hot-fix to returning visitors right
away. Package media is NOT version-stamped — a trailer
is megabytes and a copy edit must not re-download it.
order           ascending sort key for the Plaza feed; leave gaps (10,
20, 30) so a card can be inserted without renumbering.
Cache: this file is served with 'Cache-Control: no-cache' and revalidated
by ETag, so an unchanged catalog costs a 304 with an empty body and an
edited one is live on the next visit. Everything else under /games/ is
served with a one-day max-age.
